Sam (sales): heads-up: NovoBank wants SOC2 + HIPAA evidence and asks for "immutable audit-log retention up to 7 years". They want written assurance by EOW.
Anya (product): can you paste the exact asks from the RFP/email so we can map to product/contract scope? do they insist logs live in our systems for 7y or is an export OK?
Sam (sales): paste from their security lead:
> "Vendor must retain immutable audit logs for up to 7 years for certain regulated events (PII/PHI access). Logs must be retrievable for audits and litigation. Must include encryption-at-rest and demonstrable chain-of-custody."
Maria (support): sharing our standard intake snippet we send prospects:
```
- Default audit log retention: 365 days (configurable)
- Daily export option: automatic export to customer S3-compatible bucket
- Access controls: RBAC + KMS-encrypted exports
```
Jordan (security): high-level concerns: storing 7y of operational logs on hosted infra is expensive and conflicts with data minimization. Options:
1) Hot retention 30-365d + automated export to customer-managed archive (recommended)
2) Long-term retention with pseudonymization/redaction of PII (requires QA + reprocessing)
3) Dedicated/private deployment where customer controls retention and storage
Jordan (security): also need clarity on events in-scope (auth events, admin actions, content reads?). If "content access" includes prompts/responses, that's essentially storing user data for 7y and has HIPAA/PII implications.
Leo (legal): wording matters. Recommend proposing: "Vendor will provide export of audit logs to customer-controlled archive with integrity manifests; vendor retains operational logs for up to 365 days by default." Keeps liability bounded and is negotiable.
Anya (product): draft product spec proposal to translate asks into launchable scope:
- Hot retention: admin-configurable 30-365 days on hosted offering
- Export: built-in daily signed export to customer S3 or presigned URL
- Integrity: provide SHA256 manifest + signed index for each export batch
- Event scope: admin-selectable filter; by default exclude prompt/response content unless enabled by contract
- UI/SDK: tenant setting for retention + export onboarding flow
- Launch criteria: docs, SDKs, e2e archive verification tests, security sign-off, and legal-approved contract clause
Sam (sales): NovoBank says they need admin actions + access logs + a record of content access. Asking whether we consider content access PII. I'll clarify.
Jordan (security): if they want content-access records that include which user viewed content (and the content reference), that's sensitive. Recommend we only provide references (hashes, object IDs) in access logs unless customer explicitly signs for content retention.
Maria (support): operationally we already run a daily-export -> S3 lifecycle for some customers. We can reuse pipeline but need product UI and permission model. Ops runbook exists: ``export -> S3 -> lifecycle 7y``.
Anya (product): engineering ask: need rough estimate from eng-infra. Work items: export pipeline automation per-tenant, retention config in console, manifest signing, event-filter UI, contract flag for enabling content retention. @Eng Infra can you comment?
ops-bot: ticket INFRA-6423 created and routed to #eng-infra and #eng-privacy.
Eng Infra (eng-infra): quick note: feasible. Ballpark scope: 2-3 sprints to harden export automation + per-tenant configs + manifest signing. Cost on hosted infra for 7y cold storage is significant; will model costs.
Leo (legal): propose two lanes for contract negotiation:
- Hosted: vendor retains operational logs up to 365d; vendor offers export tooling and contract language shifting archive responsibility to customer
- Dedicated/Private: allow vendor to support up to 7y retention as a paid professional-services + security review engagement
Jordan (security): add mandatory data-minimization checkbox to the intake form and block hosted acceptance if customer requires us to hold PHI for 7y.
Anya (product): prioritization: NovoBank is mid-enterprise with high ARR potential. Recommend P1 backlog candidate once sales confirms intent and signs NDA. Acceptance criteria for P1:
- daily export to S3 tested end-to-end
- per-tenant retention setting (30-365d) in hosted console
- contract templates and legal signoff
- security signoff on manifests and KMS integration
Sam (sales): i'll push back with two options (A: export+customer archive, B: dedicated deployment with extended retention). will report back tomorrow.
Maria (support): action items recap:
- @Sam: clarify exact event types and whether prompt content is in-scope
- @Anya: create PRD stub + acceptance criteria and link here
- @Jordan & @Leo: draft recommended contract language + security notes
- @Eng Infra: rough estimate + feasibility note (EOD Friday)
Anya (product): i'll create the PRD stub and attach here when ready. tagging owners.
Sam (sales): thanks all, will update after customer conversation.
Jordan (security): :thumbsup:
Leo (legal): :eyes:
ops-bot: INFRA-6423 updated with comment from Anya.
